apps.name: LiveContainer Fork
apps.subtitle: LiveContainer with Shortcuts and screen broadcast for apps.
apps.localizedDescription: A fork of LiveContainer. Adds Shortcuts actions and screen broadcast for apps inside LiveContainer. Installs over LiveContainer and keeps your data. Includes the built-in SideStore.

versions.localizedDescription: Background Events: pick one app to receive Bluetooth, accessory, location and background-task events while LiveContainer is in the background. Off by default.
Stable release. SideStore now loads the source even when GitHub's API limit is reached.

Stable release. Apps' Shortcuts actions, widgets, Live Activities, share, actions, keyboards, Safari content blockers, photo editing, iMessage, call blocking, screen broadcast and Files work inside LiveContainer.
Files: every app's File Provider runs in its location, also when iOS runs them in one process. Fixes files that couldn't be opened.
Files: locations start afresh after each reinstall, deleted apps' locations are removed, and each app's settings show what its location last did.
Files: each app's location runs the app's own File Provider. Apps without one show their Documents.
Update checks and SideStore read this source through GitHub's API, so they see a new release right away and agree with each other.
Files: each app with Files turned on gets its own location in the Files app, "LiveContainer – App", showing its Documents. Old LiveContainer locations are removed.
Removes Files locations left from earlier builds, so only the LiveContainer location stays.
The update prompt now opens the built-in SideStore on My Apps, where you tap Update yourself. SideStore fetches this source fresh, so it shows new releases right away.

Screen broadcast works for many apps at once, each shown as "App - Broadcast". Apps' share extensions are listed in LiveContainer's own share item under "Share With". Files: LiveContainer's own location in the Files app, with a folder for each app that has Files turned on.

Apps' extensions get clear names: "App - Extension" for kinds several apps can have, "LiveContainer" for Files, iMessage, Screen Broadcast and SMS Filter (one app at a time). Fixes adding a Files location.

App Extensions now work like Shortcuts: turn on an app's extensions, tap Apply Changes, and LiveContainer reinstalls with that app's own extensions included, under their own names. Several apps work side by side. Files, iMessage and SMS Filter work for one app at a time (pick it in Settings → App Extensions).
App settings now have one App Extensions section with a switch for every feature, including Shortcuts. Features an app doesn't have are grayed out.

Adds Settings → Check for Updates and a check at launch. Each fork release now has its own version, so SideStore shows updates. Includes everything from 3.8.11.3: your apps' extensions run through LiveContainer.

Runs your apps' extensions through LiveContainer: share, actions, keyboard, Safari content blocker, Files, widgets and Live Activities, photo editing, iMessage, call blocking, SMS filter and screen broadcast. Keyboard, screen broadcast and SMS filter need permission per app. Updates no longer ask about app extensions.
Fixes the built-in SideStore's App Group error after installing from the source. The built-in SideStore's source is now this fork, so LiveContainer updates come from it.
First fork release, based on LiveContainer 3.8.11. Adds Shortcuts actions and screen broadcast for apps.
